articles.summary: An article by Anonymous : Target's cloud journey started about a decade ago. First there was Amazon Web Services (AWS). Followed by IBM Cloud. Then Google Cloud Platform (GCP). We have since expanded to a Hybrid-Multi-Cloud architecture with GCP and Microsoft Azure.
articles.title: The Journey to a Hybrid-Multi-Cloud

articles.summary: An article by Anonymous : We recently introduced Target’s cybersecurity tool “Merry Maker” and open sourced the framework to help others protect against digital skimming.
articles.title: Behind the Scenes of Merry Maker

articles.summary: An article by Anonymous : Credit card skimmers are custom-made additions to payment devices (like ATMs or gas pumps) that criminals build and use to steal a consumer’s payment information.
articles.title: Meet Merry Maker: How Target Protects Against Digital Skimming
